messages.subject: rmr2 with R 3.0.1
parts:
Hello everyone,
  I did some testing of rmr2 and R 3.0.1 and we have verified compatibility on a few platforms. There is one catch though, it requires reinstalling the package. It may be ignorance on my part, but I had to find out the hard way. Once reinstalled things look good. Enjoy,


Antonio
